_doc: Ratchet baseline for the methodology regression gate, kept beside its gate at scripts/diagnostics/methodology_baseline.json. See docs/STATE.md (Validation section); historical gate notes at docs/archive/METHODOLOGY-INVARIANTS.md. Each per-offense / global metric records the best-known value any future surface must not regress below. The gate (scripts/diagnostics/check_methodology_invariants.py) BLOCKS promotion on regression. A regression is NOT auto-accepted: to accept an intended tradeoff, re-run the gate with --update-baseline --rationale '<why>', which rewrites these numbers and appends to history. Never edit numbers by hand to silence a failure.
seeded_from: state/output/crimerisk_block_group_2024_ags_core.parquet (committed rate-EB surface, built 2026-06-16) for explosion/coverage/normalization metrics; murder within-city gradient seeded from brief-16 kappa sweep (TRACKER) since the shipped surface predates the within-city sharpening.

max_index._note: candidate may not exceed max(baseline*1.5, baseline+250). Catches the share-EB tiny-denominator explosion (64x) while allowing legitimate sharpening (e.g. murder 2413->2636).

p999_index._note: candidate 99.9th percentile may not materially exceed the ratcheted tail; catches broad tail inflation that a single max can miss.

cells_gt_5000._note: ratcheted: candidate count of cells with index>5000 may not exceed baseline. Murder baseline is 0 -> any >5000 murder cell blocks. Property offenses keep their real-hotspot baseline.

high_index_low_denominator_cells._note: count of cells with index>5000 and primary denominator<=10; directly catches tiny-denominator high-index artifacts.

denom_weighted_mean_index._note: national denominator-weighted mean published index must stay ~100 (normalization invariant).

published_fraction._note: guards against salvaging the map by broad blanking (the owner explicitly rejected large-scale suppression).

murder_gradient_chicago_observed_positiv._note: within-city murder neighborhood resolution (owner priority). Supply via --murder-gradient-chicago; observed 7yr truth ~28x. Guards against regressing to the flat 'jurisdiction-level murder' state.

no_support_high_index_cells._note: count of published cells with index>5000 and the diagnostic EB low-denominator flag set; the no-evidence covariate over-extrapolation failure mode (a no-data jurisdiction's official total piling onto a few BGs) proxy. Distinct from genuine incident-backed hotspots, which are allowed. Added after the 2026-06-19 over-concentration fix as a named regression check.

history.rationale: Initial ratchet from the committed rate-EB surface (clean murder: max 2413, 0 cells>5000; property offenses keep their real-hotspot maxima) plus the brief-16 within-city murder gradient (21.75x). Establishes the bar the share-EB reformulation must clear before promotion.

Ship exposure-tempered log-rate index estimator (recovered+generalized brief-14, all 7 offenses, display-layer; counts untouched). Reseed per-offense tail metrics to the shipped surface: locks in improvements (larceny max 34433->4616, MVT cells>5000 24->5, agg-assault 4->1, rape 1->0, burglary 2->1) and accepts robbery cells>5000 1->3 as genuine adequate-denominator downtown-DC/Baltimore hotspots (high_index_low_denominator stays 0; max 5473<5515). GPT Pro consulted and endorsed generalizing + accepting robbery hotspots (thesis chat 2026-06-18). Murder-gradient baseline left at 21.75; shipped 20.41 clears the 18.75 floor.

Promote coverage expansion (8 Gate-17 cities into residual-allocator training surface, 22->30; all 8 improve held-out leave-one-city-out TVD, aggregate -0.0492 vs -0.0459) + no-evidence prior fix (DEFAULT_EB_ALPHA_BY_OFFENSE rape/robbery/aggravated_assault 1->20 so block groups with NO geocoded incident data don't publish implausible covariate-extrapolated rates; with no incident support the index falls to the prior, a stronger prior pulls no-data cells toward the parent rate). Data-backed within-city gradients IDENTICAL (Chicago murder 20.41, agg 16.26; NY same). No-data tails cleared: rape/robbery/agg cells>5000 -> 0, agg max 6588->3195. Held-out TVD invariant (alpha display-only). Ratchet to the improved surface.

Final over-concentration fix (GPT Pro review): strengthen no-evidence EB prior alpha 1->20 for rape/aggravated_assault/burglary/motor_vehicle_theft (>5000 tails entirely no-incident-support covariate over-extrapolation); robbery NOT bumped (genuine incident-backed hotspots). no_support_high_index_cells sentinel=0 for all. Data-backed gradients identical alpha 1 vs 20. Coverage expansion 22->30 cities + this fix.
